title: Notes must agree at the joins.
body: Check each note where it meets another.

title: Give each note its own card.
body: Let each note keep its own shape.

title: Keep the red join red.
body: Show where teams disagree. Never paint over.

title: Map the joins, then merge.
body: Draw each link before you move a thing.

title: Show both sides of the edge.
body: Keep both. Show where they disagree.

title: One owner for every join.
body: Pick one owner for each shared piece.

title: Seven opinions, one line.
body: Let each one check with its neighbours.

title: Keep both. Mark the join.
body: Keep both. Ask a person which holds.

title: Test the gate by breaking it.
body: Break it on purpose. See if it notices.

title: Trust the parts that agree.
body: Check each part against its neighbours.

title: Fold only the joins that agree.
body: Check each join. Keep only what agrees.

title: Odd joins wait for a person.
body: Let odd parts wait for a person.

title: Every push meets the gate.
body: Check every file the moment it lands.

title: Let every join pull back.
body: Let each touching pair pull together.

title: Floppy parts have fewer joins.
body: Count how many neighbours hold each part.

title: See every link below the top.
body: Lay out every link, row by row.

title: Credit should flow down the links.
body: Pass a share down every link.

title: Draw only links you can show.
body: Draw a link only where it's written.

title: Let the unfinished joins glow.
body: Give known gaps their own colour.

title: Rules on top, parts below.
body: Put the rules first. Then the parts.

title: A wiki with pins.
body: Name what must stay true. Check every edit.

title: Merge, and keep the seams.
body: Keep both answers. Lose nothing without a note.

title: The same mistake, pinned.
body: When you find a miss, add a check.

title: Don't touch the gate.
body: Lock the checks. It may only fix.

title: We choose the pins.
body: Say what you borrowed. Say what you chose.

title: Try first. Then the gate opens.
body: Hide the answer until you try.

title: Find the pin first.
body: Turn it around. Find what doesn't move.

title: Small changes, one counter.
body: Keep a running total. Stop when full.

title: AI writes. The gate checks.
body: Let it write small batches. Check each one.

title: Two copies, one seam.
body: Compare both copies on every change.

title: Give every note a label.
body: Label each note by what it is.

title: Hand over only the right cards.
body: Give it only what this job needs.

title: One fact at every joint.
body: Send one fact. Check every copy.

title: Private cards stay home.
body: Mark private notes. Check before they leave.

title: Send the wiring, not the pile.
body: Send how parts connect, not every line.

title: Draw the sockets first.
body: Draw each step with its sockets.

title: See every joint first.
body: Map every part and what it calls.

title: Add the missing piece.
body: Don't jam it. Put a converter between.

title: Each helper gets its own part.
body: Give each helper its own separate part.

title: Find the joint that slipped.
body: Build it twice. Compare at every joint.

title: Build it once, with slots.
body: Write the steps once. Leave blanks for facts.

title: Stop when the counter hits zero.
body: Let fresh eyes list the fixes. Repeat.

title: Send only what clears the gate.
body: Score every answer. Send only above the bar.

title: One line for every puzzle.
body: Ask for one method that solves all.

title: Every try gets a tick.
body: Write down every try and its result.

title: A small gate picks the road.
body: Size the task first. Then pick the road.

title: Check every join in the chain.
body: Check the work between every step.

title: Keep the judge pinned.
body: Lock the test. Only the work may change.

title: One change, then measure.
body: Change one thing. Measure. Keep or undo.

title: Let it draft the cards first.
body: Ask it to write the prompt first.

title: Hunches don't fit the slot.
body: Let only real test results ship it.

title: When unsure, the gate stays shut.
body: When unsure, stop. Go only on clear yes.

title: Every step gets a tick.
body: Write down each step. Pay once, last.

title: Doing waits behind the gate.
body: Let it write. Let rules decide the send.

title: Five small gates, not one.
body: Ask five small questions, not one big one.

title: First, check the ruler.
body: Check the ruler before you trust the score.

title: Coin flips go to a person.
body: If it's a coin toss, ask a person.

title: Leave the flag where it is.
body: Mark every mismatch. Do not smooth it.

title: Every claim faces the same gates.
body: Test every paper the same few ways.

title: Readers pass a one-way gate.
body: Give readers a copy with no keys.

title: Every miss gets a new gate.
body: Let a machine check every run.

title: Add a different gate.
body: Add a check that looks somewhere new.

title: Turn every miss into a gate.
body: Make each miss a new check.

title: The old bug hits a gate.
body: Keep the old bug. Make it fail.

title: Fresh eyes try to break it.
body: Let someone who didn't build it check.

title: Check the pin before the work.
body: Test the rule, not only the work.

title: Find the first broken joint.
body: Check each step where it meets the next.

title: Show one real example.
body: Ask for one example you can try.

title: Seven gates watch every frame.
body: Give each kind of flaw its own check.

title: Check the work, not its label.
body: Look at what really came out.

title: Every answer keeps its receipt.
body: Tag each note with where it came from.

title: Give every note a label.
body: Say how sure. Only raise it by checking.

title: Every step leaves a mark.
body: Write each step down. Go on green.

title: Draw only the joins you see.
body: Draw what the source shows. Mark the gaps.

title: Test where the parts join.
body: Test the joins, not just the parts.

title: A gate after every step.
body: Check after every step, not just the end.

title: Let the check only look.
body: Keep looking apart from changing.

title: Some numbers get a pin.
body: Lock the numbers that must not move.

title: Start with the small card.
body: Start small. Open more only if needed.

title: Three runs, one gate.
body: Build it three ways. Trust what all agree.

title: Let the colours ring.
body: Hear the whole set at once.

title: Keep the reading pair pinned.
body: Pin the reading pair. Check it every time.

title: Three parts, many songs.
body: Build from a few parts you can check.

title: Finished is when every gate opens.
body: Let a machine check it. Fix. Repeat.

title: Shrink it through the gates.
body: Remove one thing at a time. Check each.

title: Draw the order as one line.
body: Write the order down before anything runs.

title: Pull every thread into view.
body: Draw the links, not just the notes.

title: Every shape gets one pin.
body: One shape, one meaning. Keep a shelf.

title: Taste, one tick at a time.
body: Pick one of two, again and again.

title: Every sound on the tick.
body: Place each sound on the picture's clock.

title: Every frame lives on the line.
body: Draw each moment from the clock alone.

title: Every join must hold.
body: Ship only the cut where parts join.

title: Two copies, one card.
body: Give each shared part one owner.

title: Run the ring end to end.
body: Check the whole film, not a peek.

title: Nothing fake gets past the door.
body: Check every package is real first.

title: Turn each rule into a door.
body: Turn each rule into a check.

title: The old bug meets a door.
body: Ship each fix with its own check.

title: Lay the cards side by side.
body: Find two cases your score cannot split.

title: Every version gets a tick.
body: Stamp each version and link it back.

title: Put a ring on every turn.
body: Measure each turn before anyone sees it.
